result.summary: The page is largely well-structured, with consistent typography, a clear promo banner, and a tidy bottom navigation bar. The main visible defect is a vertical misalignment in the 'Fastest near you' row, where the Smash Bros Burgers card sits lower than its neighbors, so its title and delivery fee don't line up. A few minor styling and contrast points were also noted. Clipped carousel items and the partially visible card at the bottom were excluded as intended features.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' row, the Smash Bros Burgers card is offset downward relative to the Green Bowl Poké and Trattoria cards. Its image top, title ('Smash Bros Burgers') and delivery fee sit about 28px lower, so the card titles and prices are misaligned across the row.
issues.suggestion: Make the carousel cards share the same top alignment and fixed height, so image, title and delivery fee baselines line up across all cards.

issues.description: The heart (favorite) buttons on the restaurant cards use inconsistent backgrounds. The Tokumaru card uses a light-translucent circle while the pizza card uses a darker, more opaque circle, so the control looks different from card to card.
issues.suggestion: Apply one consistent background style and size to the favorite button across all restaurant cards.

issues.description: Secondary gray text, such as the search placeholder, delivery fees and the '25–35 min' meta line, appears low in contrast against the white background, which may be hard to read for some users.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color to meet WCAG AA contrast (at least 4.5:1 for normal text).
